name: Canva Magic Studio
knownFor: AI writing, image, presentation, and design tools inside Canva, including Magic Write and other Magic Studio features. Canva itself is a widely used design app; it is not listed on the Image generation or Photo editing pages.
popCaption: 954.6M web visits to canva.com in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026). That figure is the Canva platform as a whole, not only Magic Studio · checked Nov 2026
learn: Everyday design, social posts, and decks with built-in AI tools
pro: Enormous everyday reach, with Magic Studio sitting inside an editor people already use
con: Visit counts measure all of Canva, not Magic Studio alone, and some AI tools draw from a monthly allowance
costCaption: Typical plan: Pro US$144/year for one person (about $12/month billed yearly), which includes premium AI tools (canva.com/pricing, checked Nov 2026). Business is US$250/year per person.

name: Notion AI
knownFor: AI writing, Q&A, and agents inside the Notion workspace, including Notion Agent and AI meeting notes on the Business plan.
popCaption: 175.3M web visits to notion.com in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026). That figure is the Notion workspace as a whole, not only Notion AI · checked Nov 2026
learn: Notes, docs, and team wikis with a built-in AI assistant
pro: AI sits in the same workspace as the docs and databases people already keep there
con: Full Notion Agent features are on Business, not on the cheaper Plus plan, which only includes an AI trial
costCaption: Typical plan for the AI features: Business $20 per member/month, labeled Recommended, which includes Notion Agent (notion.com/pricing, checked Nov 2026). Plus is $10 per member/month and includes only a trial of Notion AI. Business seat pricing.

name: Salesforce Agentforce
knownFor: AI agents for sales, service, and other CRM work on the Salesforce platform, sold as Agentforce licenses and usage-based credits.
popCaption: 111.9M web visits to salesforce.com in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026). That figure is the Salesforce company site, which also covers many products besides Agentforce · checked Nov 2026
learn: AI agents inside a large CRM, for sales and service teams
pro: Tied into Salesforce customer data, so agents can act in the same system reps already use
con: Website visits are for salesforce.com as a whole, and pricing mixes seat licenses with usage-based Flex Credits
costCaption: Typical published seat: Agentforce User License $50 USD/user/month (salesforce.com/agentforce/pricing, checked Nov 2026). Other Agentforce uses are sold as Flex Credits or as part of larger editions (Max Edition from $550/user/month was also listed). Business pricing; confirm with the vendor.

name: Zendesk AI
knownFor: AI agents, Copilot, and automation inside Zendesk’s customer-service platform, with ticketing, messaging, and help-center tools.
popCaption: 61.0M web visits to zendesk.com in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026). That figure is the Zendesk platform as a whole, not only the AI agents · checked Nov 2026
learn: Customer support teams that want AI agents in a help desk
pro: AI agents are included on Suite plans, with a large existing support-platform customer base
con: The typical Suite plan is a business seat price, and automated resolutions have additional usage charges
costCaption: Typical plan: Suite Professional $115/agent/month paid yearly, labeled most popular (zendesk.com/pricing, checked Nov 2026). Suite Team, which includes AI Agents, is $55/agent/month paid yearly. Support Team is $19/agent/month paid yearly. Automated resolutions are billed on usage. Business seat pricing.

name: Grammarly
knownFor: A widely used AI writing assistant for grammar, tone, rewrites, and generation, in the browser, desktop, and mobile apps. Grammarly is now part of Superhuman.
popCaption: 58.9M web visits to grammarly.com in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026). Official plans page says trusted by over 40 million people and 50,000 organizations (vendor claim) · checked Nov 2026
learn: Everyday writing help in email, docs, and the browser
pro: Works in the places people already write, with a large consumer and workplace audience
con: Now part of the Superhuman suite, which can make the product family confusing next to Superhuman Mail
costCaption: Typical plan: Pro $12/member/month billed annually ($144/year), or $30/member/month billed monthly (grammarly.com/plans and Grammarly Support, “How much does Grammarly Pro cost?”, checked Nov 2026).

name: HubSpot (Breeze AI)
knownFor: A marketing, sales, service, and CRM platform with built-in Breeze AI agents and assistants for content, prospecting, and support.
popCaption: 44.1M web visits to hubspot.com in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026). That figure is the HubSpot platform as a whole, not only Breeze AI · checked Nov 2026
learn: Small and mid-size teams that want CRM, marketing, and AI in one platform
pro: A full customer platform with a free CRM tier and Breeze Assistant included on paid Core Seats
con: Visit counts measure all of HubSpot, and paid hubs plus seats can add up quickly past Starter
costCaption: Typical entry paid seat: Starter Core Seat $20/month per seat, which includes built-in AI with Breeze Assistant (legal.hubspot.com/hubspot-product-and-services-catalog, checked Nov 2026). Marketing Hub Starter was also shown as starting at $20/month per seat, with a limited-time new-customer price from $10 (hubspot.com/products/marketing/get-started). Business seat pricing.

name: QuillBot
knownFor: An AI writing assistant used to paraphrase, check grammar, summarize, detect AI text, and cite sources, popular with students and everyday writers.
popCaption: 36.6M web visits to quillbot.com in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026) · checked Nov 2026
learn: Paraphrasing, grammar help, and everyday writing cleanup
pro: A simple, widely used writing toolkit with a real free tier
con: More of a writing utility than a full workplace suite
costCaption: Typical plan: Premium $8.33/month billed annually as $99.95, or $19.95/month (official QuillBot blog, “How much is QuillBot Premium?”, quillbot.com/blog, checked Nov 2026).

name: ClickUp Brain
knownFor: AI assistants and agents (Brain²) inside ClickUp, used to search work, write, update tasks, and generate docs in the same workspace.
popCaption: 33.9M web visits to clickup.com in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026). That figure is the ClickUp workspace as a whole, not only Brain · checked Nov 2026
learn: Project and task management with a built-in AI assistant
pro: Brain² is built into ClickUp plans, so AI sits next to tasks, docs, and chat
con: Premium models and a larger credit allowance sit on Business and higher plans, not on Core alone
costCaption: Typical plan for Brain² Premium Models: Business $17/user/month billed yearly (clickup.com/pricing, checked Nov 2026). Core is $9/user/month billed yearly. Every plan includes some Brain² and a credit allowance; Business includes premium models. Max is $100/user/month billed yearly.

name: Gamma
knownFor: An AI tool for turning a prompt or outline into presentations, documents, websites, and social graphics, then editing them in place.
popCaption: 20.8M web visits to gamma.app in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026) · checked Nov 2026
learn: Fast decks, one-pagers, and simple sites from a prompt
pro: A focused AI presentation and doc tool with very high traffic for a standalone app
con: Official dollar prices on gamma.app/pricing could not be captured as text this session, so the cost band is an estimate
costCaption: Editorial estimate for a typical individual paid plan in the $$ band. Gamma’s help center lists Free, Plus, Pro, Ultra, and Business plans with monthly or annual billing, but no public dollar figure was captured from gamma.app/pricing this session · checked Nov 2026

name: GoHighLevel (HighLevel)
knownFor: An all-in-one marketing and CRM platform for agencies and local businesses, with funnels, email and SMS, calendars, and built-in Conversation AI, Voice AI, and Content AI.
popCaption: 14.2M web visits to gohighlevel.com in October 2026 (Semrush, last updated November 11, 2026). That figure is the HighLevel platform as a whole. A SeekTool Similarweb figure was not found for this domain this session · checked Nov 2026
learn: Agencies and local businesses that want CRM, funnels, and AI in one platform
pro: Replaces a stack of marketing tools, with agency plans for reselling to clients
con: Priced for businesses and agencies, not a casual personal app, and phone, SMS, and some AI features have usage charges
costCaption: Typical entry plan: Starter $97/month, or $970/year, for one business or a few clients (gohighlevel.com/pricing, checked Nov 2026). Unlimited is $297/month, or $2,970/year; Pro is $497/month, or $4,970/year. Business pricing; usage charges apply for phone, SMS, email, and some AI features.

name: Superhuman
knownFor: A fast email client with Superhuman AI for drafting and inbox work. Superhuman now also includes Grammarly, Coda, and Superhuman Go; Grammarly is listed separately on this page.
popCaption: 6.51M web visits to superhuman.com in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026) · checked Nov 2026
learn: People who live in email and want a faster client with AI drafts
pro: A focused, paid email experience with AI built into the inbox
con: The Superhuman name now also covers a wider suite, so site traffic may include more than the Mail app
costCaption: Typical plan: Superhuman Mail Starter $25 per member/month, billed annually (superhuman.com/mail/pricing, checked Nov 2026). A Business plan was also listed. Business seat pricing.

name: Intercom Fin
knownFor: Fin, Intercom’s AI customer-support agent, which answers questions across chat, email, phone, and other channels, either inside Intercom or on another help desk.
popCaption: 4.47M web visits to intercom.com in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026). That figure is the Intercom platform as a whole, not only Fin · checked Nov 2026
learn: Support teams that want an AI agent to resolve common questions
pro: Fin is included on Intercom plans and can also run on another help desk, with a clear per-outcome price
con: Seat plus per-outcome pricing can climb with volume, and visits measure Intercom as a whole
costCaption: Typical plan: Essential $19/seat/month billed annually, or $29/seat/month billed monthly, plus $0.99 per Fin outcome on all plans (intercom.com/pricing, checked Nov 2026). Fin can also be used with another help desk at $0.99 per outcome with no seat required. Business pricing.

name: Jasper
knownFor: An AI marketing platform for on-brand content, campaigns, and marketing agents, aimed at marketing teams rather than general chat.
popCaption: 373.0K web visits to jasper.ai in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026) · checked Nov 2026
learn: Marketing teams that want on-brand content and campaign workflows
pro: Built around brand voice and marketing workflows, not generic chat
con: Much smaller web traffic than the large workplace suites on this page, and the Business plan is quote-only
costCaption: Typical public plan: Pro $59/month billed yearly, or $69/month billed monthly (jasper.ai/pricing, checked Nov 2026). Business is custom pricing (contact sales); Jasper’s FAQ calls Business the most popular plan for teams, but it has no public individual price.

name: Copy.ai
knownFor: An AI platform for go-to-market work: writing, sales outreach, and automated workflows across marketing and sales teams.
popCaption: 344.3K web visits to copy.ai in October 2026 (Similarweb estimates via SeekTool, October 2026) · checked Nov 2026
learn: Sales and marketing teams automating outreach and copy workflows
pro: Combines writing tools with GTM workflows and a published self-serve Chat plan
con: Web traffic is modest next to the large platforms on this page, and higher plans jump to four-figure monthly prices
costCaption: Typical entry plan: Chat $24/month billed annually as $288/year, or $29/month billed monthly, for a 5-seat plan (copy.ai/pricing, checked Nov 2026). Growth starts at $1,000/month. Business pricing.
